craft_notes: Sthāyin: unborn-source (self-made-self-spoken-power-risen: four self-attributes then BEGINNINGLESS-unborn: the temporality is inverted: unborn FROM beginningless — both negatives stacked). Rows: row 2 (supreme→unborn). Close: become (bhavet — optative AGAIN: even the unborn is may-be-attained: permission-refrain at the source-verse). Rejected: 'eternal' — killed: beginningless kept (anādi as the negation of origin, not positive eternity); 'manifests' — killed: power-risen kept (śakti-saṃbhūtā: SHE rises, the clause's subject).

lines: unborn from beginningless — one may become.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jñānaprakāśakaṃ sarvaṃ sarveṇātmā prakāśakaḥ | ekam ekasvabhāvatvāt jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ vibhāvyate

reads_against.argmap: How is everything lit? → From one-nature, one self lights all — knowing and knowable are one vision.
c1_essence: One-nature lighting all: knowing and known one vision.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with śānta (wonder settled into stillness)
